adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a test quality issue in the diff. Looking at lines 119-129 of the spec file, the test adds only one user to the group, then removes that user and asserts `group.users.count.should == 0`. This test would pass even if the implementation incorrectly deleted ALL members instead of just the specified user. A more robust test would add multiple users and verify only the targeted user was removed while others remain. This is a legitimate test coverage concern for newly added functionality, not a bug in the production code itself.
